command:
set -euo pipefail
sudo cp -p /etc/k0s.yaml /etc/k0s.yaml.before-audit
sudo install -d -m 0750 -o kube-apiserver -g kube-apiserver /var/log/kubernetes
sudo install -m 0640 -o root -g kube-apiserver /tmp/qa-audit-policy.yaml /etc/k0s/audit-policy.yaml
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='/etc/k0s.yaml';d=json.load(open(p));a=d['spec']['api'].setdefault('extraArgs',{});a.update({'audit-policy-file':'/etc/k0s/audit-policy.yaml','audit-log-path':'/var/log/kubernetes/audit.log','audit-log-maxage':'30','audit-log-maxbackup':'10','audit-log-maxsize':'200'})
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d))
PY
sudo /usr/local/bin/k0s config validate --config /etc/k0s.yaml
sudo systemctl restart k0scontroller
